meaning:
θαμβέω, -ῶ
(θάμβος) [in LXX for בָּעַת ni., pi., etc. ;]
1. to be amazed.
2. In late Gk., to astonish, terrify (2Ki.22:5): pass., Mrk.1:27 10:32; before ἐπί with dative of thing(s), Mrk.10:24.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: They were all amazed, so that they questioned among themselves, saying, “What is this? A new teaching? For with authority he commands even the unclean spirits…
